programme.title: 64 Minutes - race against time / 64 Minutes - Wettlauf gegen die Zeit
programme.desc: The policeman Frank Penny is responsible for money in a explosive case. The victim of the victim is the eleven -year daughter of the police chief. However, the handover does not go according to plan, whereupon Penny shoots the Doller. But only he knew where the little girl stayed. Penny now has 64 minutes to find the girl, otherwise it drowns in a water tank. He receives support from the ambitious reporter Ava Brooks. / Der Polizist Frank Penny ist fur eine Geldubergabe in einem brisanten Entfuhrungsfall zustandig. Bei dem entfuhrten Opfer handelt es sich um die elfjahrige Tochter des Polizeichefs. Die Übergabe verlauft jedoch nicht nach Plan, woraufhin Penny den Entfuhrer erschieSSt. Doch nur er wusste, wo sich das kleine Madchen aufhalt. Penny hat nun 64 Minuten Zeit, das Madchen zu finden, ansonsten ertrinkt es in einem Wassertank. Unterstutzung erhalt er dabei von der ehrgeizigen Reporterin Ava Brooks.

programme.title: Football - World Cup qualifications / Fudbal - Kvalifikacije za Svjetsko prvenstvo
programme.desc: Over two hundred Members of the World Fique football organization competes in the qualifications for the main tournament of the World Football Championship. These long and above all tense qualifications differ depends on which continental confederation is working. But in common Everyone is that the rights of the oversula is for the final tournament given the very large bet they play. The importance of qualifications is additional that no one except the host has no right to participate in the final tournament and and world champions must confirm their visa in order to be able to defend the title. / Preko dvjesto članica svjetske nogometne organizacije Fife takmiči se u kvalifikacijama za glavni turnir svjetskog nogometnog prvenstva. Ove dugačke i nadasve napete kvalifikacije se razlikuju ovisi o kojoj se kontinentalnoj konfederaciji radi. No, zajedničko svima je da su prava uvertira za završni turnir s obzirom na jako veliki ulog za koji igraju. Značaj kvalifikacija je dodatan što niko osim domaćina nema pravo učestvovanja na završnom turniru te i svjetski prvaci moraju potvrditi svoju vizu kako bi mogli braniti naslov.

programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - English League / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Every August 20 team begins hunting at the most respected trophy of English football. The English Premier in the format in which the game was founded in 1992. programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: American Football - NFL / Američki fudbal - NFL
programme.desc: The largest and most popular American football league in the world's NFL was founded in 1920. years, but only by merging with competing AFL in the middle of the last century, today's version of the competition was created. 32 teams divided into two conferences in the league. During the regular season, each team plays 16 games. The six best teams conferences enter the playoffs to the big final, popularly called superbol. The superbol is played in early February and is the most probable sports event on the planet. / Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. Po šest najboljih ekipa konferencija ulazi u plej-of do velikog finala, popularno nazvanog Superbol. Superbol se odigrava početkom februara i medijski je najpropraćeniji sportski događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Athletics: World Cup in Tokyo / Лека атлетика: Световно първенство в Токио
programme.desc: The best competitors in the Queen of Sports gather in Tokyo. 2200 athletes, representatives of 198 countries, will start in the Japanese capital in the first major outdoor championship from the new Olympic cycle. Rising stars and well-established characters will fight for the 49 sets of medals that will be distributed in Tokyo. The hosts of the championship and world athletics have taken into account the program so that all the most interesting disciplines are at a convenient time to watch in Europe. Bulgaria will be represented by its four best competitors. The European champion in a hall in the length of Bozhidar Saraboyukov will fight for a place among the best in the discipline. 10 years after her fourth place in Beijing, Gabriela Petrova will try to rank among the finalists on a triple jump. Plamen Mitkova in the length of length will again look for her place among the world elite after the fourth position of the World Championship in the hall in March. Tihomir Ivanov strives for the second consecutive planetary level after the eighth place last year at the Olympic Games in Paris. / Най-добрите състезатели в Царицата на спортовете се събират в Токио. 2200 лекоатлети, представители на 198 страни, ще стартират в японската столица в първия голям шампионат на открито от новия олимпийски цикъл. Изгряващи звезди и утвърдени герои ще влязат в борба за 49-те комплекта медали, които ще се разпределят в Токио. Домакините на шампионата и Световната атлетика са съобразили програмата така, че всички най-интересни дисциплини да бъдат в удобно за гледане в Европа време. България ще бъде представена от четиримата си най-добри състезатели. Европейският шампион в зала в скока на дължина Божидар Саръбоюков ще се бори за място сред най-добрите в дисциплината. 10 години след четвъртото си място в Пекин, Габриела Петрова ще се опита да се нареди сред финалистките на троен скок. Пламена Миткова в скока на дължина отново ще търси своето място сред световния елит след четвъртата позиция на световния шампионат в зала през март. Тихомир Иванов се стреми към втори пореден финал на планетарно ниво след осмото място през миналата година на Олимпийските игри в Париж.

programme.title: Spartan race / Надпревара "Спартан"
programme.desc: These are exhausting competitions that combine running for endurance, strength and mental resistance. Participants are oriented through a series of obstacles designed to experience the limit on their borders. They can include climbing walls, heavy wearing objects, rope climbing, mud pits and fire. / Това са изтощителни състезания, които съчетават бягане за издръжливост, сила и психическа устойчивост. Участниците се ориентират през поредица от препятствия, предназначени да изпитат предела на техните граници. Те могат да включват стени за изкачване, тежки предмети за носене, катерене по въжета, кални ями и огън.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Dr. Blake / Мистериите на доктор Блейк
programme.desc: The sectarian Ethan is the last to see Vern Armstrong alive. Therefore, the suspicions fall on it. But Dr. Blake finds strange deficiencies and coincidences pointing to another perpetrator. / Сектантът Итън е последният, който е видял жив Върн Армстронг. Затова подозренията падат върху него. Но д-р Блейк открива странни липси и съвпадения, сочещи към друг извършител.

programme.title: Hall of Fame: Evulanda Slavcheva / Зала на славата: Евладия Славчева
programme.desc: "Hall of Fame" is a section in which we present the most famous faces of the great golden galaxy of Bulgarian athletes. These significant names, which, with their success over the years, have enjoyed sports lovers in our country. In the Hall of Glory, they tell about themselves - about successes, disappointments, difficulties, peaks, about the past and the present, about sports, which plays a huge role in life and for life after sports. Thanks to the rich archive of Bulgarian National Television, you will have the opportunity to see the biggest successes of the stars of Bulgarian sport. / "Зала на славата" е рубрика, в която представяме най-известните лица от голямата златна плеяда български спортисти. Тези значими имена, които със своите успехи през годините са радвали любителите на спорта в нашата страна. В "Зала на славата" те разказват за себе си - за успехите, разочарованията, трудностите, върховете, за миналото и настоящето, за спорта, който играе огромна роля в живота и за живота след спорта. Благодарение на богатия архив на Българската национална телевизия ще имате възможност да видите и най-големите успехи на звездите на българския спорт.

programme.title: Fight: World Cup: Freestyle, Finals / Борба: Световно първенство: Свободен стил, финали
programme.desc: Bulgaria will be represented by 14 competitors. The first free -style participants will be released on the Tepeha, who will distribute medals in the days from September 14 to 16. Seven will be the Bulgarian fighters - Ivaylo Tisov /57 kg /, Mikya Naim /65 kg /, Mihail Georgiev /70 kg /, Ramadan Ramazanov /74 kg /, Ahmed Bataev /92 kg /, Ahmed Magamaev /97 kg /and Alen Hubulov /125 kg /. The women enter the battle for the honors from September 16 to September 18, with the Bulgarians will be 3 - Bilyana Dudova /62 kg /, Juliana Yaneva /68 kg /and Vanessa Georgieva /76 kg /. The last three days have been designated for the classical style categories, with four being there will be the Bulgarian representatives there - Nikolay Vichev /63 kg /, David Dimitrov /72 kg /, Stoyan Kubatov /77 kg /and Daniel Alexandrov /87 kg /. / България ще бъде представена от 14 състезатели. Първи на тепеха излизат участниците в свободния стил, които ще разпределят медалите в дните от 14 до 16 септември. Седем ще са българските борци – Ивайло Тисов /57 кг/, Микяй Наим /65 кг/, Михаил Георгиев /70 кг/, Рамазан Рамазанов /74 кг/, Ахмед Батаев /92 кг/, Ахмед Магамаев /97 кг/ и Ален Хубулов /125 кг/. Жените влизат в битка за отличията от 16 до 18 септември, като там българките ще бъдат 3 – Биляна Дудова /62 кг/, Юлияна Янева /68 кг/ и Ванеса Георгиева /76 кг/. Последните три дни са отредени за категориите в класическия стил, като четирима ще бъдат българските представители там – Николай Вичев /63 кг/, Дейвид Димитров /72 кг/, Стоян Кубатов /77 кг/ и Даниел Александров /87 кг/.

programme.title: Cycling: Tour of Germany / Колоездене: Обиколка на Германия
programme.desc: The tour of Germany is one of the largest and most prestigious cycling competitions in Germany. This is a multi -day race, which is usually held in late summer and attracts top cyclists from around the world. Germany is known for its beautiful and diverse routes that offer both flat stages and serious mountain climbs, which makes the competition extremely exciting and contested. / Обиколката на Германия е едно от най-големите и престижни състезания по колоездене в Германия. Това е многодневно състезание, което обикновено се провежда в края на лятото и привлича топ колоездачи от целия свят. Германия е известна със своите красиви и разнообразни маршрути, които предлагат както равнинни етапи, така и сериозни планински изкачвания, което прави състезанието изключително вълнуващо и оспорвано.

programme.title: The Croatia thriller: hunt for a dead man / Der Kroatien-Krimi: Jagd auf einen Toten
programme.desc: Commissioner Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat) experiences a shock when she discovered a familiar necklace on a burned body. The head of the Split homicide commission believes that her ex-fishing Milan (Henning Vogt) was the victim of a disguised murder attack. However, it soon shows that the dead person is someone else: Gore Memic (Robert Besta) from a famous mafia clan of the capital Zagreb. Now Milan is suspected of having exchanged his death in order to go into being. How close she is to the durable night club owner, Stascha does not mention her superior Kovacic (Max Herbrechter) as well as a violent examination of Memic the evening before in Milan's club. She believed that in which Bargast had the rapist of her younger sister Minka (Jenny Meyer) in front of her. However, Minka vehemently deny this and even surprises later with accusations against Milan. Has Stascha completely exchanged in her great love? In the meantime, the commissioner trusts her "ex" everything - from dirty ones to violent crimes. To find him, she even rushes the underworld boss Zlatan Memic (Ralf Dittrich) on his neck, who liked his son. Stasha's plan to let the mafia drive to the search, but harbors incalculable risks. / Kommissarin Stascha Novak (Jasmin Gerat) erlebt einen Schock, als sie eine ihr vertraute Halskette an einer verbrannten Leiche entdeckt. Die Leiterin der Mordkommission Split glaubt, dass ihr Ex-Verlobter Milan (Henning Vogt) das Opfer eines getarnten Mordanschlags wurde. Schon bald zeigt sich jedoch, dass es sich bei dem Toten um jemand anderen handelt: Gore Memic (Robert Besta) aus einem beruchtigten Mafiaclan der Hauptstadt Zagreb. Nun steht Milan unter dem Verdacht, seinen Tod vorgetauscht zu haben, um unterzutauchen. Wie nahe sie dem fluchtigen Nachtklubbesitzer steht, verschweigt Stascha ihrem Vorgesetzten Kovacic (Max Herbrechter) ebenso wie eine heftige Auseinandersetzung mit Memic am Vorabend in Milans Klub. Sie glaubte, in dem Bargast den Vergewaltiger ihrer jungeren Schwester Minka (Jenny Meyer) vor sich zu haben. Minka verneint dies aber vehement und uberrascht spater sogar mit Anschuldigungen gegen Milan. Hat sich Stascha in ihrer groSSen Liebe komplett getauscht? Inzwischen traut die Kommissarin ihrem "Ex" alles zu - von schmutzigen Geschaften bis zu Gewaltverbrechen. Um ihn ausfindig zu machen, hetzt sie ihm sogar den Unterweltboss Zlatan Memic (Ralf Dittrich) auf den Hals, der seinen Sohn rachen mochte. Staschas Plan, sich von der Mafia zu dem Gesuchten fuhren zu lassen, birgt jedoch unkalkulierbare Risiken.

programme.title: Dead shadow / Todliche Schatten
programme.desc: The murder of two colleagues presents the Berlin LKA with great challenges: both police officers had neither professional nor privately in contact - where is the connection? Commissioner Philip Nabrow (Walter Sittler), as brilliantly as stubborn, and his colleague Frauke Johannsen (Charlotte Irene Thompson) determine in all directions: Murder from Refuge? Protection funds? Homophobia or clan-skilled? But the different traces run into nothing. However, when the police boxing club jerks at the center of the investigation, the case takes an unexpected turn: in the club, which is led by former police officer Hartmut Jenke (Rainer Woss), Nabrow's daughter Elisa (Hannah Ehrlichmann) is also involved in the case. As much as Nabrow hangs on his daughter and her work hesitates, the plidious close cooperation gives him discomfort, because: Nabrow has secrets that he wants to hide from all circumstances from Elisa. Does Nabrow lose control? His superior and best friend Fred Keitel (Uwe Preuss) has every reason to worry, especially since the case is becoming increasingly complex and dangerous. And suddenly Nabrow himself becomes a hunted! / Der Mord an zwei Kollegen stellt das Berliner LKA vor groSSe Herausforderungen: Beide Polizisten hatten weder beruflich noch privat Kontakt - wo ist die Verbindung? Kommissar Philip Nabrow (Walter Sittler), ebenso brillant wie dickkopfig, und seine Kollegin Frauke Johannsen (Charlotte Irene Thompson) ermitteln in alle Richtungen: Mord aus Auslanderhass? Schutzgelderpressung? Homophobie oder Clan-Geschafte? Doch die verschiedenen Spuren laufen ins Leere. Als jedoch der Polizei-Boxclub ins Zentrum der Ermittlungen ruckt, nimmt der Fall eine unerwartete Wende: Im Club, der von dem ehemaligen Polizisten Hartmut Jenke (Rainer Woss) geleitet wird, wird kraftig gedealt - so dass auch Nabrows Tochter Elisa (Hannah Ehrlichmann) aus dem Drogendezernat in den Fall involviert wird. So sehr Nabrow an seiner Tochter hangt und ihre Arbeit schatzt, die plotzliche enge Zusammenarbeit bereitet ihm Unbehagen, denn: Nabrow hat Geheimnisse, die er unter allen Umstanden vor Elisa verbergen will. Verliert Nabrow die Kontrolle? Sein Vorgesetzter und bester Freund Fred Keitel (Uwe Preuss) hat allen Grund zur Sorge, zumal der Fall immer komplexer und gefahrlicher wird. Und auf einmal wird Nabrow selbst zum Gejagten!

programme.title: The Amsterdam thriller: the dirt of the others / Der Amsterdam-Krimi: Der Dreck der Anderen
programme.desc: Commissioner Bram de Groot (Fedja van Huet) and his team are played up a distant video: At a gauze deponation in Malaysia, the dead body of a little boy lies between highly toxic September! The trace goes to the renowned recycling company "Golden Wings Logistics", which is based in Amsterdam, whose owner Laura Lee (Joy Maria Bai) is a personality, which is raised because of her social engagement. A procedure against Lee can only take place with an out -of -date sensitivity. Bram de Groot Schleust Alex Pollack (Hannes Jaenicke), his specialists for undercover campaigns, in the company. A wire rope act for the experienced police officer, who is drawn deeper and deeper into the criminal machinations during his action. He finds evidence of illegal mulling and drug smuggling. A raid fails - was it pierced? Is there a trial in Bram's team? The location is heading when Alex suddenly disappeared without a trace. / Kommissar Bram de Groot (Fedja van Huet) und seinem Team wird ein verstorendes Video zugespielt: Auf einer Mulldeponie in Malaysia liegt der tote Korper eines kleinen Jungen zwischen hochgiftigem Sondermull aus Europa! Die Spur fuhrt zu dem renommierten, in Amsterdam ansassigen Recyclingunternehmen "Golden Wings Logistics", dessen Eigentumerin Laura Lee (Joy Maria Bai) eine wegen ihres sozialen Engagements hochgeachtete Personlichkeit ist. programme.title: Zora in the morning / Zora am Morgen
programme.desc: Zora's days start Fruh - if most of her friends are still sleeping firmly, she is already training with her gymnastics teacher. Tomorrow she should be examined - maybe she can even go to the national championship? But nobody suspects that Zora has another passion - she loves football. programme.title: Tiger ducks club / Tigerenten Club
programme.desc: In an emergency you will be called! Christian Manshen and Mike Rauch give insights into their job as an emergency afternoon in the "Tigerenter Club". How do you stop on an emergency call, how does first aid work and what happens in an ambulance? In their humorous and encouraging way, the sanitators and influencers show how everyone can provide first aid in an emergency. With their profit, the classes support the children's aid campaign "Heart Safe" by SWR and SR. / Bei einem Notfall werden sie gerufen! Christian Manshen und Mike Rauch geben im "Tigerenten Club" Einblicke in ihren Job als Notfallsanitater. Wie verhalt man sich bei einem Notruf, wie funktioniert Erste Hilfe und was passiert in einem Rettungswagen? programme.title: Incredibly perfect friends / Unheimlich perfekte Freunde
programme.desc: Emil and Frido are best friends. When the mirror images of the two are brought to life in a mirror cabinet, the ten -year boys believe that they have pulled the big lot: the double gangs can do everything that Frido and Emil themselves cannot do so well, but they expect their ambitious parents from them. But when their images suddenly begin to pursue their own goals, the two friends have to find a way to get rid of the uncanny spirits they called. But that is more difficult than expected. / Emil und Frido sind beste Freunde. Als in einem Spiegelkabinett auf dem Jahrmarkt die Spiegelbilder der beiden zum Leben erweckt werden, glauben die zehnjahrigen Jungs, das groSSe Los gezogen zu haben: Die Doppelganger konnen namlich all das, was Frido und Emil selbst nicht so gut konnen, ihre ambitionierten Eltern aber von ihnen erwarten. Doch als ihre Abbilder plotzlich beginnen, eigene Ziele zu verfolgen, mussen die beiden Freunde einen Weg finden, die unheimlichen Geister, die sie riefen, wieder loszuwerden. programme.title: Animals up to the roof / Tiere bis unters Dach
programme.desc: Jakob's seventiest birthday is imminent. His childhood friend Otto suddenly appears, who makes a surprise visit with his elderly Labrador Hannibal. Jakob didn't really want to celebrate. But in contrast to Jakob, Otto is a happy journeyman who, especially through Hannibal, conquered the hearts of the children at the horse farm and reminds Jakob of an old promise that must now be accorded. The promise means a lot of fun, but no peace. But shortly before the big day, Hannibal collapses. Kajo's diagnosis is clear: the Labrador has a tumor. Can the children's darling be saved? What will become of Jakob's birthday party? / Jakobs siebzigster Geburtstag steht bevor. Plotzlich taucht sein Jugendfreund Otto auf, der mit seinem betagten Labrador Hannibal einen Überraschungsbesuch macht. Jakob wollte eigentlich keinesfalls feiern. Doch Otto ist im Gegensatz zu Jakob ein frohlicher Geselle, der vor allem durch Hannibal die Herzen der Kinder auf dem Pferdehof erobert und Jakob an ein altes Versprechen erinnert, das jetzt eingelost werden musse. Das Versprechen bedeutet viel SpaSS, aber keine Ruhe. Doch kurz vor dem groSSen Tag bricht Hannibal zusammen. Kajos Diagnose ist eindeutig: Der Labrador hat einen Tumor. Kann der Liebling der Kinder noch gerettet werden? Was wird aus Jakobs Geburtstagsfeier?

programme.title: The tricks with ... / Die Tricks mit ...
programme.desc: Whether fragrance promises, magical "renew" effects or XXL washing machines with a questionable drum size: a current NDR research for the competence center consumers reveals what is behind the marketing tricks of the detergent industry and how consumers are encouraged to buy. Pods and even washing leaves. The manufacturers promise the best washing results for all products. Which really washes best, reveal tests at the Niederrhein University of Applied Sciences. For a long time, detergents should no longer only clean the clothes. The products should also smell good too! Parliamented detergents are often advertised with "aromatherapy" or "deodorant fresh". But warning consumer protection: fragrances are not harmless to health and are critical of the environment in large quantities. Much of what the industry sells as an innovation is not used for clean washing - on the contrary. Interested in particular: detergent ingredients such as phosphonates or river plastics get over clarifiers into the river and can lead to environmental damage there. The latest research even suggests that the controversial glyphosate in waters is partly caused by degradation processes of detergent components. Many rates promise loads with eight, nine or even eleven kilos. But the NDR research shows that machines with identical drum -size, but with different large details, are sold - at different prices and with different energy efficiency labeling. Because when calculating the energy class, manufacturers have scope. Consumer protection demands: The criteria have to be stricter. In "the tricks with detergent, fabricate and Co." Find Anna Planken and Jo Hiller and the editorial team of the NDR: Not everything that smells cleans. And not everything that glows is good for health or environment. Anyone who dispenses with troubles and detergents properly dosed, but also washes more comfortable, but also more sustainable. / Ob Duftversprechen, magische "Renew"-Effekte oder XXL-Waschmaschinen mit fragwurdiger TrommelgroSSe: Eine aktuelle NDR-Recherche fur das Kompetenzcenter Verbraucher deckt auf, was hinter den Marketingtricks der Waschmittelindustrie steckt und wie Verbraucher zum Kaufen animiert werden.Die Produktvielfalt in den Regalen ist riesig: von Flussigwaschmitteln uber Pulver bis hin zu Kapseln, Pods und sogar Waschblattern. Bei allen Produkten versprechen die Hersteller beste Waschergebnisse. Welches wirklich am besten wascht, offenbaren Tests an der Hochschule Niederrhein. Waschmittel sollen allerdings langst nicht mehr nur die Kleidung reinigen. Gut riechen sollen die Produkte auch! Parfumierte Waschmittel werden oft mit "Aromatherapie" oder "Deo-Frische" beworben. Doch Verbraucherschutzer warnen: Duftstoffe sind gesundheitlich nicht unbedenklich und in groSSen Mengen kritisch fur die Umwelt. Vieles, was die Industrie als Innovation verkauft, wird fur saubere Wasche nicht gebraucht - im Gegenteil.Besonders besorgniserregend: Waschmittelinhaltsstoffe wie Phosphonate oder Flussigkunststoffe gelangen uber Klaranlagen in die Flusse und konnen dort zu Umweltschaden fuhren. Neueste Forschungen legen sogar nahe, dass das umstrittene Glyphosat in Gewassern teilweise durch Abbauprozesse von Waschmittelbestandteilen entsteht.Nicht nur bei Waschmitteln, auch bei Waschmaschinen wird getrickst. Viele Gerate versprechen Beladungen mit acht, neun oder sogar elf Kilo Wasche. Doch die NDR-Recherche zeigt: Es werden Maschinen mit identischer TrommelgroSSe, aber mit unterschiedlichen GroSSenangaben verkauft - zu unterschiedlichen Preisen und mit unterschiedlicher Energieeffizienzkennzeichnung. Denn bei der Berechnung der Energieklasse haben Hersteller Spielraum. Verbraucherschutzer fordern: Die Kriterien mussen strenger werden.In "Die Tricks mit Waschmittel, Weichspuler und Co." finden Anna Planken und Jo Hiller sowie das Redaktionsteam des NDR heraus: Nicht alles, was duftet, reinigt auch. Und nicht alles, was glanzt, ist gut fur Gesundheit oder Umwelt. Wer auf uberflussige Zusatze verzichtet und Waschmittel richtig dosiert, wascht nicht nur gunstiger, sondern auch nachhaltiger.

Mit einer so reprasentativen Prasenz der Polizei haben aber wiederum die Tater nicht gerechnet - es wird fur beide Seiten brenzlig.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: A young man is found dead on the roadside in the winter Einode of Schleswig-Holstein, just dressed in his underpants. Apparently heavily alcoholic he fell asleep and frozen at night. The commissioners learn from the pregnant girlfriend of the dead that Sebastian wanted to celebrate the expectant fatherhood with friends in the "Schrottfabrik" large discotheque. But it is 20 kilometers from the site. He could have walked this route impossible in his full frenzy. What happened in the last hours before his death? Finn has the victim's mobile data evaluated. Accordingly, the drunk Sebastian near the discotheque was taken up by the police. That night the experienced police chief Rolf Asmus and the police aging Dennis Funke, a nephew of the prosecutor Hilke Zobel, were on patrol. The two police officers claim that they had brought the man to the next taxi rank. There he was not seen by anyone. And why didn't the police not report the use of the provision? When Finn and Lars want to interview the police, Hilke Zobel tears the case. / Ein junger Mann wird, nur mit seiner Unterhose bekleidet, tot am StraSSenrand in der winterlichen Einode Schleswig-Holsteins aufgefunden. Offenbar stark alkoholisiert war er in der Nacht eingeschlafen und erfroren. Von der schwangeren Freundin des Toten erfahren die Kommissare, dass Sebastian die werdende Vaterschaft mit Freunden in der GroSSdiskothek "Schrottfabrik" feiern wollte. Doch die liegt 20 Kilometer vom Fundort entfernt. Diese Strecke konnte er in seinem Vollrausch unmoglich zu FuSS gelaufen sein. Was geschah in den letzten Stunden vor seinem Tod? Finn lasst die mobilen Daten des Opfers auswerten. Demnach ist der betrunkene Sebastian nahe der Diskothek von der Polizei aufgegriffen worden. In dieser Nacht waren der erfahrene Polizeihauptmeister Rolf Asmus und der Polizeianwarter Dennis Funke, ein Neffe der Staatsanwaltin Hilke Zobel, zusammen auf Streife. Die beiden Polizisten behaupten, dass sie den Mann zum nachsten Taxistand gebracht hatten. Dort wurde er aber von niemandem gesehen. Und warum haben die Polizisten den Einsatz nicht vorschriftsgemaSS gemeldet? Als Finn und Lars die Polizisten befragen wollen, reiSSt Hilke Zobel den Fall an sich.

programme.title: Right in the middle - Frankfurt Airport / Mittendrin - Flughafen Frankfurt
programme.desc: "Phoenix -e" - that is the name of the most strong fully electronic aircraft tractor in the world. With 165 kWh performance and 100 percent green electricity, the huge tractor easily pulls a Boeing 777, says Achim Kahl. He is a team leader and e-tractor driver. Parkchaos in front of the terminal. Hup concerts, cursing drivers - holidaymakers, businessmates, pick -up and taxi drivers arise almost every day in the short -term parking spaces before Terminal 1. Caltred, unfalling, false parking - he has to convince drivers on site every day, to stick to the rules. / "Phoenix-E" - so heiSSt der starkste vollelektronische Flugzeugschlepper der Welt. programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: The civil engineer Uwe Trimborn collapses after a jogging run. He is found by Bente Willemsen, who has been going to Krucken since a serious bicycle accident, and her daughter Ronja in front of her home. The poisoned Trimborn was the volunteer of Bente Willemsen. He helped her on behalf of the church at shopping and accompanied her to visits to the doctor. In the hospital, the doctors find that the engineer who falled into the coma was poisoned with a pesticide. Could Uwe Trimborn have been the victim of a food presser? The Lubeck commissioners find that the poison was in an isotonic drink that he drank during the jogging. The poison was demonstrably mixed only after the purchase. This means that the extension theory is off the table. Commissioner Nina Weiss finds out that Trimborn had no order from the Church to help Bente. How did he know about Bentes fate and why did he seek contact with her? When the commissioners decide the background of the case, it is almost too late. / Der Bauingenieur Uwe Trimborn bricht nach einem Jogginglauf zusammen. Er wird von Bente Willemsen, die seit einem schweren Fahrradunfall an Krucken geht, und ihrer Tochter Ronja vor ihrer Haustur gefunden. Der vergiftete Trimborn war der ehrenamtliche Helfer von Bente Willemsen. Er hat ihr im Auftrag der Kirche bei Einkaufen geholfen und sie zu Arztbesuchen begleitet. Im Krankenhaus stellen die Ärzte fest, dass der ins Koma gefallene Ingenieur mit einem Pflanzenschutzmittel vergiftet wurde. Konnte Uwe Trimborn Opfer eines Lebensmittelerpressers geworden sein? Die Lubecker Kommissare finden heraus, dass sich das Gift in einem isotonischen Getrank befand, das er wahrend des Joggens getrunken hat. Das Gift wurde nachweislich erst nach dem Kauf untergemischt. Damit ist die Erpressertheorie vom Tisch. Kommissarin Nina Weiss findet heraus, dass Trimborn gar keinen Auftrag der Kirche hatte, Bente zu helfen. Woher wusste er uberhaupt von Bentes Schicksal und wieso hat er den Kontakt zu ihr gesucht? Als die Kommissare die Hintergrunde des Falls entschlusseln, ist es fast zu spat.

programme.title: Knowledge before eight - future / Wissen vor acht - Zukunft
programme.desc: The roundabout as an energy storage has a long history that extends until the 1950s, as gyro buses with rotating windows drove through the city as a drive. Researchers from the TU Dresden have now built the world's greatest rotating flywheel memory. It is to be used to compensate for current fluctuations in large wind turbines. Anja Reschke explains exactly how this works and what the other advantages of this mechanical method are in "Knowledge before eight - future". / Der Kreisel als Energiespeicher hat eine lange Geschichte, die bis in die 1950er-Jahre zuruckreicht, als Gyro-Busse mit rotierenden Scheiben als Antrieb durch die Stadte fuhren. Forschende der TU Dresden haben nun den bisher groSSten rotierenden Schwungrad-Speicher der Welt gebaut. Er soll eingesetzt werden, um Strom-Schwankungen groSSer Windkraftanlagen auszugleichen. Wie das genau funktioniert und was die weiteren Vorteile dieser mechanischen Methode sind, erklart Anja Reschke in "Wissen vor acht - Zukunft".

In Norway's fjords, orcas and humpback whales side side by side, while life in the ocean shines in magical light while on the Kuste of Ireland. / Vom gefrorenen Polarmeer, wo Eisbaren und Rentiere ums Überleben kampfen, bis zu den warmen Stranden des Mittelmeers, wo Flamingos und farbenfrohe Korallen leben - die dynamischen Kusten Europas sind Schauplatz einiger der spektakularsten Naturereignisse unseres Kontinents. programme.title: Hard but fair / Hart aber fair
programme.sub-title: Sozialstaat zu teuer - Bullshit oder bittere Wahrheit?
programme.desc: A summer of the coalition dispute comes to an end. Is there now an "autumn of the reforms" that Chancellor Friedrich Merz has disgruntled? Because in financial planning by 2029, more than 170 billion euros are missing. Should the Federal Government therefore have a strong burden or should social benefits be buried? Everyone is wondering: What can the Union and SPD agree on pension, taxes and agree with the burger money? / Ein Sommer des Koalitionsstreits geht zu Ende. Kommt jetzt ein "Herbst der Reformen",den Kanzler Friedrich Merz angekundigt hat? Denn in der Finanzplanung bis 2029 fehlen mehr als 170 Milliarden Euro. Sollte die Bundesregierung deshalb Vermogende starker belasten oder sollten Sozialleistungen gekurzt werden? Alle fragen sich: Worauf konnen sich Union und SPD bei Rente, Steuern und beim Burgergeld einigen?

programme.title: My body. My heart. / Mein Korper. Mein Herz.
programme.desc: The heart is the most unusual muscle of our body. It works immurid, begins to beat in the womb and can even continue when the brain is already exposed. It strikes relatively, 24 hours a day, and especially at a young age, we hardly pay attention to him. They are sporty, get healthy and feel fit. But you don't know whether your heart is really healthy. Your genetic risks or concrete values ​​are unknown to you. For ARD, let your heart examine your heart in Koln by Conchita Ruiz-Mohne. The cardiologist is an expert for female heart and tap medicine, an area that has been neglected for a long time. Because women's hearts are different from men. In an infarction, they often show different, non -specific symptoms than men, which can lead to dangerous spades. In the event of a heart attack, every minute pays: As soon as the blood supply stops, heart tissue begins irretrievably. Important knowledge, because it is not unlikely to have to do first aid yourself. Heart attacks in Germany are the most common cause of death. This affects increasingly young people - especially young men under 40. So also Ferruccio Labita, who had a heart attack at the age of 38. Today he trusts his heart again and rides bike races with passion. But he has learned that performance must never go beyond one's own body. A great risk factor is stress. The heart can make the heart sick in particular up to the "Broken Heart Syndrome". Christiane Waller explains why the hormone oxytocin can play a protective role. Freight divers Anna Karina Schmitt shows how to encounter the stress with breathing: With targeted exercises, her heart is preparing for diving courses up to 80 meters deep - with just one breath. / Das Herz ist der ungewohnlichste Muskel unseres Korpers. Es arbeitet unermudlich, beginnt im Mutterleib zu schlagen und kann sogar weitermachen, wenn das Gehirn schon aussetzt. Es schlagt zuverlassig, 24 Stunden am Tag, und besonders in jungen Jahren schenken wir ihm kaum Beachtung.Etwa so geht es auch den 29-jahrigen Zwillingen Naomi und Joëlle Karfich. Sie sind sportlich, ernahren sich gesund und fuhlen sich fit. Doch ob ihr Herz wirklich gesund ist, wissen sie nicht. Ihre genetischen Risiken oder konkrete Werte sind ihnen unbekannt. Fur ARD Wissen lassen sie ihr Herz in Koln von Conchita Ruiz-Mohne untersuchen. Die Kardiologin ist Expertin fur weibliche Herz- und GefaSSmedizin, ein Bereich, der lange vernachlassigt wurde. Denn Frauenherzen sind anders als Mannerherzen. Sie zeigen bei einem Infarkt oft andere, unspezifischere Symptome als Manner, was zu gefahrlich spaten Diagnosen fuhren kann. Dabei zahlt bei einem Herzinfarkt jede Minute: Sobald die Blutzufuhr stockt, beginnt Herzgewebe unwiederbringlich abzusterben.Wie man bei einem Herzinfarkt schnell und richtig handelt, zeigt Sanitaterin Celine Kilian. Wichtiges Wissen, denn es ist nicht unwahrscheinlich, selbst einmal Erste-Hilfe leisten zu mussen. Herzinfarkte sind in Deutschland die haufigste Todesursache. Betroffen sind davon zunehmend jungere Menschen - insbesondere jungere Manner unter 40. So auch Ferruccio Labita, der mit 38 Jahren einen Herzinfarkt hatte. Heute vertraut er seinem Herzen wieder und fahrt mit Leidenschaft Radrennen. Doch er hat gelernt, dass Leistung nie uber das eigene Korpergefuhl hinausgehen darf.Ein groSSer Risikofaktor ist Stress. Besonders zwischenmenschlicher Dauerstress kann das Herz krank machen bis hin zum "Broken Heart Syndrom". Christiane Waller erklart, warum das Hormon Oxytocin dabei eine schutzende Rolle spielen kann. Wie man dem Stress mit Atmung begegnet, zeigt Freitaucherin Anna Karina Schmitt: Mit gezielten Übungen bereitet sie ihr Herz auf Tauchgange bis zu 80 Meter Tiefe vor - mit nur einem Atemzug.

programme.title: Work 4.0 - Does AI break my job? / Arbeit 4.0 - Macht KI meinen Job kaputt?
programme.desc: Sure, Y-History reporter Julia Freistedt also researches with artificial intelligence. So she was never afraid for her job: "After all, I do something with my head. Nobody can take that away from me." But now she wonders: how long? Julia experiences with doctors, journalists and researchers what artificial intelligence can do - and what she may be better than we do. Google developers show her a translator AI that interprets in real time-with Julia's own voice! At the Heidelberg Cancer Research Center, AI examines one of its birthmarks. "They only have about half the mistakes they had at the specialist screening," explained the dermatologist Titus Brinker. And with the fact checkser Teresa Dapp, she searches for video fakes. Not so easy, she thinks: "You had to deal with tools really well to false something. With AI this is a breeze." There were already three industrial revolutions. Jobs were lost there - but new ones were always created. And for most people that meant: more prosperity. But what is coming now? Is that really "only" work 4.0, with the risks and side effects? Or ki ki on a big style jobs - also Julias? She climbs deep into the film, and somehow it seems familiar to her: our fears (robots build cars), our dreams (composing music machines) - everything doesn't sound so new. And sometimes Julia also finds something to laugh: the electronic marriage broker was a pretty cool lead for Tinder and Co. ... / Klar, Y-History-Reporterin Julia Freistedt recherchiert auch mit kunstlicher Intelligenz. Angst um ihren Job hatte sie deswegen nie: "Ich mache schlieSSlich was mit dem Kopf. Das kann mir keiner wegnehmen." Doch mittlerweile fragt sie sich: Wie lange noch? Julia erlebt mit Ärzten, Journalistinnen und Forscherinnen, was kunstliche Intelligenz kann - und was sie moglicherweise besser kann als wir. Google-Entwickler zeigen ihr eine Übersetzer-KI, die in Echtzeit dolmetscht - mit Julias eigener Stimme! Am Heidelberger Krebsforschungszentrum untersucht die KI eins ihrer Muttermale. "Dabei haben Sie nur etwa die Halfte der Fehler, die Sie beim Facharzt-Screening hatten", erklart ihr der Hautarzt Titus Brinker. Und mit der Faktencheckerin Teresa Dapp fahndet sie nach Video-Fakes. Gar nicht so einfach, findet die: "Fruher musste man mit Tools richtig gut umgehen konnen, um was zu falschen. Mit KI ist das ein Kinderspiel."Drei industrielle Revolutionen gab es schon. Da gingen Jobs verloren - aber es entstanden immer auch neue. Und fur die meisten Menschen hieSS das: mehr Wohlstand. Aber was kommt jetzt? Ist das echt "nur" Arbeit 4.0, mit den ublichen Risiken und Nebenwirkungen? Oder killt KI im groSSen Stil Jobs - auch Julias? Sie steigt tief ins Filmarchiv, und da kommt ihr einiges irgendwie bekannt vor: Unsere Ängste (Roboter bauen Autos), unsere Traume (Musikmaschinen komponieren) - das klingt alles gar nicht so neu. Und manchmal findet Julia auch was zum Lachen: Der elektronische Heiratsvermittler war 1963 jedenfalls ein ziemlich cooler Vorlaufer fur Tinder and Co. ...

programme.title: Crime scene / Tatort
programme.desc: The discovery of a body raises questions: The man missing in the river near Nurnberg was buried two meters deep in the earth for two years. The bicycle handler Andreas Schonfeld (Benjamin Schaefer), which was 37 years old at the time of death, was considered friendly and popular with the neighbors, and yet the Frankish investigators have to find out: He did not have a nearby environment. Chief Criminal Investigation Commissioner Felix Voss (Fabian Hinrichs) - in his first case without his long -term partner Paula Ringelhahn, but the most supported by Wanda Goldwasser (Eli Wasscheid) and his current driver Fred (Sigi Zimmerschied) - asks: What connections have been done to the cruel death of the bicycle handler? A visit to the mother of the Tested, Erika Schonfeld (Marion Reuter), brings a loving mother-son relationship, the pain is great. During the further attempt to reconstruct Schonfeld's life, Felix and Wanda come across the blind Lisa Blum (Mavie Horbiger). / Der Fund einer Leiche wirft Fragen auf: Zwei Meter tief in der Erde war der seit zwei Jahren vermisste Mann in der Flussaue nahe Nurnberg begraben. Der zum Todeszeitpunkt 37-jahrige Fahrradhandler Andreas Schonfeld (Benjamin Schaefer) galt als freundlich und bei den Nachbarn beliebt, und doch mussen die frankischen Ermittler feststellen: Ein naheres Umfeld hatte er nicht. Kriminalhauptkommissar Felix Voss (Fabian Hinrichs) - in seinem ersten Fall ohne seine langjahrige Partnerin Paula Ringelhahn, aber aufs Starkste unterstutzt von Wanda Goldwasser (Eli Wasserscheid) und seinem derzeitigen Fahrer Fred (Sigi Zimmerschied) - fragt sich: Welche Verbindungen haben zum grausamen Tod des Fahrradhandlers gefuhrt? Ein Besuch bei der Mutter des Getoteten, Erika Schonfeld (Marion Reuter), bringt ein liebevolles Mutter-Sohn-Verhaltnis zu Tage, der Schmerz ist groSS. Bei dem weiteren Versuch, Schonfelds Leben zu rekonstruieren, stoSSen Felix und Wanda auf die blinde Lisa Blum (Mavie Horbiger).

programme.title: orientation / Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. programme.title: orientation / Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

programme.title: Theme / Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. programme.title: Human / iHuman
programme.desc: Everyone is talking about Chatgpt. The mastermind behind the technology developed at Openaai is Ilya Sutskever, one of the experts who have their say in "Ihuman". The discussion, which has so far been played primarily into insider circles, about the profound consequences of artificial intelligence has been beating tall waves since Chatgpt4's discarding. "Ihuman" is a political thriller. He feels like a science fiction film and is about the here and now. The documentary reveals of artificial intelligence, power and social control. With a unique access to the booming AI industry, he shows how the most powerful technology of all time has our society, our future and our self-understanding. What are the consequences of the concentration of power of the billion dollar AI industry that knows hardly any state regulation and transparency? Die bisher vor allem in Insiderkreisen gefuhrte Diskussion uber die tiefgreifenden Konsequenzen von Kunstlicher Intelligenz schlagt seit der Veroffentlichung von ChatGPT4 hohe Wellen."iHuman" ist ein politischer Thriller. Er fuhlt sich an wie ein Science-Fiction-Film und handelt doch vom Hier und Jetzt. Der Dokumentarfilm erzahlt von kunstlicher Intelligenz, Macht und sozialer Kontrolle. Mit einzigartigem Zugang zur boomenden KI-Industrie zeigt er, wie die machtigste Technologie aller Zeiten unsere Gesellschaft, unsere Zukunft und unser Selbstverstandnis verandert. Welche Konsequenzen hat die Machtkonzentration der milliardenschweren KI-Industrie, die kaum staatliche Regulierung und Transparenz kennt? programme.title: orientation / Orientierung
programme.desc: On March 24, 1980, 45 years ago, Archbishop Oscar Romero was shot in the altar in San Salvador. The murder was part of a large wave of violence that the small Central American country had grasped. Campesinos, human rights activists, but also committed laypersons, religious sisters and priests were murdered in the struggle of militars and death squads that defended the interests of a rich upper class. Dying was not over with the death of Romero. A burger war broke out on the day of his grant. Militar and Guerilla (FMLN) had a 12 -year -old man. The 80,000 people were killed. After the 1992 peace conclusion, the country suffered from the violence of youth gangs, the so -called Maras. The blood collar remained high. Like many other people, Oscar Romero died for justice. He became an icon over the years. On the one hand, he is laughing mildly of painting and posters today, but on the other hand he has nothing of his radiance. Not only for those who knew him, but also for young people, he has become a role model. Because the use for justice is no less necessary today than it was at the time. / Am 24. Marz 1980, also vor 45 Jahren, wurde in San Salvador Erzbischof Oscar Romero am Altar erschossen. Der Mord war Teil einer groSSen Welle der Gewalt, die das kleine mittelamerikanische Land erfasst hatte. Im Kampf von Militars und Todesschwadronen, die die Interessen einer reichen Oberschicht verteidigten, wurden Campesinos, Menschenrechtsaktivistinnen und -aktivisten, aber auch engagierte Laien, Ordensschwestern und Priester ermordet. Mit dem Tod Romeros war das Sterben nicht zu Ende. Am Tag seines Begrabnisses brach ein Burgerkrieg aus. Militar und Guerilla (FMLN) bekampften einander 12 Jahre lang. An die 80.000 Menschen kamen ums Leben. Nach dem Friedensschluss 1992 hatte das Land unter der Gewalt von Jugendbanden, den sogenannten Maras, zu leiden. Der Blutzoll blieb hoch. Oscar Romero starb wie viele andere Menschen im Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit. Er wurde im Lauf der Jahre zur Ikone. Einerseits lachelt er heute mild von Gemalden und Plakaten, andererseits aber hat er nichts von seiner Strahlkraft eingebuSSt. Nicht nur fur die, die ihn kannten, sondern auch fur junge Menschen ist er zum Vorbild geworden. Denn der Einsatz fur Gerechtigkeit ist heute nicht weniger notwendig, als er damals war.

And it outlines the political upheavals and upheavals that still commend the escape issue. / Zehn Jahre ist es her, dass sich eine Million Menschen auf den Weg nach Europa gemacht haben. Die Bilder von langen FuSSmarschen aus Ungarn nach Österreich, von uberfullten Bahnhofen und eingedruckten Grenzzaunen gingen um die Welt. Die Dokumentation blickt zuruck und fragt: Wo stehen wir heute? Wie hat das pragende Jahr 2015 Österreich und seine Gesellschaft verandert? Von den dramatischen Szenen an den Grenzen bis hin zu den Herausforderungen der Integration.Das Filmteam begleitet Menschen, die damals geflohen sind, zeigt deren Geschichten von Verlust, Hoffnung und Neuanfang. Es fuhlt den Erfahrungen und Erlebnissen von Österreichern und Österreicherinnen nach - zwischen Hilfsbereitschaft und Angst, Willkommenskultur und Ablehnung. Und es skizziert die politischen Verwerfungen und Umbruche, die das Fluchtlingsthema bis heute pragen.

programme.title: Theme / Thema
programme.desc: Fight for the monastery - three nuns want to stay "I am guaranteed not to die in the nursing home. I prefer to lie down on a meadow," says monastery nurse Bernadette. Together with Regina and Rita, she has been making headlines at home and abroad for days. The Augustiner choir women are 81, 86 and 88 years old. They have also been house -occupiers since last week. Due to their age, they have been gradually moved to a retirement home for them for them. The sisters don't want to accept that. On your own you have returned to the Goldenstein monastery Sudlich from Salzburg, where you have been living for 70 years. The sisters raise heavy pouring: money and cars are said to have disappeared, the access to their accounts was suddenly not possible. However, the public prosecutor has hired the investigation. The explanation for many open questions is in a centuries -old celebration that the sisters once did. Laura Mlakar and Oliver Rubenthaler report on a story between humanity and canon law. A year after the flood - as required in Atzenbrugg "We can live again at home, but the psyche is not as quickly renovated as the house," says Werner Haselmayer. A year ago, he was saved from his house in Atzenbrugg with a boat. After it rains continuously for several days in September last year, the Perschlingdamm breaks in several places. The water floods the southern part of Atzenbrugg. Sabine Zischkin can also live in her house again today. The water was one meter high in her living room. "I am afraid that all the strength we put into the renovation was in vain when such a flood comes again," she says. How safe is the dam today - a year after the catastrophe? And how did the life of those affected change? A report of Savanka black. 30 years of the topic: We look back - 9/11 The terrorist attack in New York the most people still know what they did that day: On September 11, 2001, two passenger aircraft fly into the Tower of the World Trade Center. It is part of a series of attacks by the Al-Quaida terrorist group, in which almost 3000 people die. Styrian Ursula Ueltzhoeffer loses her husband John, who at that time works in one of the tower. From one minute to the other, she is alone with three small children. "Jakob was four at the time, he at all not understood that someone does something on purpose, he just wanted to know where the pilot was flown in and whether he did not see the tower," says Ursula Ueltzhoeffer later. Eva Kordesch looks back on the topic reports about people from Austria who have witnessed the attack and for whom nothing was like afterwards. / Kampf ums Kloster - drei Nonnen wollen bleiben"Ich sterbe garantiert nicht im Pflegeheim. Da leg ich mich lieber auf eine Wiese", sagt Klosterschwester Bernadette. Gemeinsam mit Regina und Rita sorgt sie seit Tagen fur Schlagzeilen im In- und Ausland. Die Augustiner-Chorfrauen sind 81, 86 und 88 Jahre alt. Seit letzter Woche sind sie auch Hausbesetzerinnen. Aufgrund ihres Alters wurden sie seit 2023 nach und nach von dem fur sie zustandigen Probst in ein Seniorenwohnheim ubersiedelt. Das wollen die Schwestern nicht hinnehmen. Auf eigene Faust sind sie ins Kloster Goldenstein sudlich von Salzburg zuruckgekehrt, wo sie seit 70 Jahren leben. Die Schwestern erheben schwere Vorwurfe: Geld und Autos sollen verschwunden, der Zugriff auf ihre Konten plotzlich nicht mehr moglich gewesen sein. Die Staatsanwaltschaft hat das Ermittlungsverfahren jedoch eingestellt. Die Erklarung fur viele offene Fragen steckt in einem jahrhundertalten Gelubde, das die Schwestern einst geleistet haben. Laura Mlakar und Oliver Rubenthaler berichten fur THEMA uber eine Geschichte zwischen Menschlichkeit und Kirchenrecht.Ein Jahr nach der Flut - nachgefragt in Atzenbrugg"Wir konnen wieder zuhause wohnen, aber die Psyche ist nicht so schnell saniert wie das Haus", sagt Werner Haselmayer. Vor einem Jahr wird er mit einem Boot aus seinem Haus in Atzenbrugg gerettet. Nachdem es im September vergangenen Jahres mehrere Tage ununterbrochen regnet, bricht der Perschlingdamm an mehreren Stellen. Das Wasser uberschwemmt flutartig den sudlichen Teil von Atzenbrugg. Auch Sabine Zischkin kann heute wieder in ihrem Haus wohnen. In ihrem Wohnzimmer stand das Wasser einen Meter hoch. "Ich habe Angst, dass all die Kraft, die wir in die Renovierung gesteckt haben, umsonst war, wenn noch einmal so ein Hochwasser kommt", sagt sie. Wie sicher ist der Damm heute - ein Jahr nach der Katastrophe? Und wie hat sich das Leben der Betroffenen verandert? Eine Reportage von Savanka Schwarz.30 Jahre THEMA: Wir blicken zuruck - 9/11 Der Terroranschlag in New YorkDie meisten Menschen wissen noch, was sie an diesem Tag gemacht haben: Am 11. September 2001 fliegen in New York zwei Passagierflugzeuge in die Turme des World Trade Center. Es ist ein Teil einer Anschlagsserie durch die Terrorgruppe Al-Quaida, bei der fast 3000 Menschen sterben. Die Steirerin Ursula Ueltzhoeffer verliert dabei ihren Mann John, der zu diesem Zeitpunkt in einem der Turme arbeitet. Von einer Minute auf die andere ist sie mit drei kleinen Kindern allein. "Jakob war damals vier, er hat uberhaupt nicht verstanden, dass sowas jemand mit Absicht macht, er wollte immer nur wissen, wo der Pilot hingeflogen ist und ob er die Turme nicht gesehen hat", sagt Ursula Ueltzhoeffer spater. Eva Kordesch blickt zuruck auf THEMA-Reportagen uber Menschen aus Österreich, die den Anschlag miterlebt haben und fur die danach nichts mehr so war wie zuvor.

programme.title: Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson / Black + White - Jazzlegende Oscar Peterson
programme.desc: The Canadian jazz pianist Oscar Peterson was a legend during his lifetime. From none other than Duke Ellington describes the "Maharaya of the Key", Oscar Peterson is one of the most technically sophisticated and melodic pianists in the history of jazz. In his more than 70-year career, he made 200 own albums and is to be heard on around 400 more, sold more records and gave more concerts than any other pianist in the history of Jazz.Barry Avrich has compiled innumbered archive excerpts from interviews and concert recordings and lets music large ones like Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock and Billy Joel have their say. / Der kanadische Jazzpianist Oscar Peterson war schon zu Lebzeiten eine Legende. Mal jahrt, zeigt der ORF ein Portrat des Klaviervirtuosen.Von niemand Geringerem als Duke Ellington als der "Maharaja der Tasten" bezeichnet, gilt Oscar Peterson als einer der technisch raffiniertesten und melodisch innovativsten Pianisten in der Geschichte des Jazz. In seiner mehr als 70-jahrigen Karriere hat er 200 eigene Alben veroffentlicht und ist auf etwa 400 weiteren zu horen, hat mehr Platten verkauft und mehr Konzerte gegeben als jeder andere Pianist in der Geschichte des Jazz.Barry Avrich hat fur seinen Film unzahlige Archiv-Ausschnitte aus Interviews und Konzertaufnahmen zusammengetragen und lasst Musik-GroSSen wie Ella Fitzgerald, Quincy Jones, Herbie Hancock und Billy Joel zu Wort kommen.

programme.title: Home Austria / Heimat Österreich
programme.desc: The Tennengau and the Kleinarltal in the Salzburg region are more than just breathtaking landscapes - they are treasury of living traditions, supported by people who love their roots and at the same time look a look forward. Embedded in this region full of timeless protective narrated hidden farmers' farm from a world in which the original peasantry is lived with joy and dedication. For example on the Kurzegg Alm, where the Schiefer family lovingly renovated the alpine pasture at 1709 meters of Seehohe and bake fresh sourdough bread for the guest in their old bread oven. In St. Martin in the Tennengebirge, the mountain farm of the Leutgeb family is located at 900 meters high. Hof-Erbin Jenny Leutgeb is involved with heart and mind for the preservation of biodiversity: Haflinger horses, Krainer Steinschaffe and the rare dark bee find a home here. At the foot of the Tennen Mountains, in Kuchl, the Biobauerhof Geyerspichl is located by the Springl family. Here Sepp Springl maintains a rather unusual breed for the region: East Frisian milk sheep. In addition to agriculture, Sepp Springl is dedicated to his second passion: the carpenter.
